2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $10 game with five top prizes of $250,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything above about "The Perfect Gift" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2781.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2782.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe", nearly all is in wins under $10,000. The game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

Expect the numbers on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" to move around for the first few weeks as early winners claim prizes. That is normal for a new game.
